goal: What was the total duration of cycling activities in the OpenTracks app this week? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer in minutes as a single integer.
summary:
I answered **588** minutes, but this relies on the activity icons. I didn't open the tracks to check their category text.

This week is Monday Oct 9 to Sunday Oct 15, and four tracks in that range have the bicycle icon in OpenTracks:

| Track | Day | Duration | Minutes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bicycle Adventure | Wednesday | 3:45:00 | 225 |
| Light Workout | Wednesday | 2:15:00 | 135 |
| Cycle Trip | Wednesday | 2:48:00 | 168 |
| Lunch Break Fitness | Monday | 1:00:00 | 60 |
| **Total** | | | **588** |

- **"Light Workout" and "Lunch Break Fitness"** count only because of the bike icon; their names don't say cycling.
- **"Rowing Expedition"** (Monday, 2:51:00) has a generic icon, so I left it out; it could be in a different category.
- **"Singletrack Session"** (4 Oct) has a mountain-bike icon but falls before this week, so it doesn't count.
